description: Generate a harmonious palette in OKLCH. Keep colors you already have, pick a style (auto, analogous, complementary, triadic, monochromatic, pastel, vivid, muted, dark) and pass a seed to get the same palette every time.

keep.description: Colors that must stay in the palette, in order

items.description: Any color: #ff5733, rgb(255 87 51), hsl(11 100% 60%), oklch(68% 0.21 34), a CSS or common name like navy, or a Tailwind class like sky-500

seed.description: Any text. The same seed gives the same palette

name: generate_palette
title: Generate a palette
